name: Kazaoka Mari
source: Manager at the editing department of Kaiousha's Kaiou Graph magazine and Haruki's boss, she is a workaholic among workaholics who relentlessly prioritizes her career above all else. Her uncompromising drive for professional success often comes at the expense of personal relationships and emotional fulfillment.
